# `core/EngineIntegration.js`

> **Source:** `engine/core/EngineIntegration.js`

EngineIntegration.js - Integration helpers for existing game code Provides easy integration of the high-performance resource management system with the existing game engine. ⚠️ MULTIPLAYER: Uses deterministic RNG from AIRandom.js

## Classes

### `class SoAParticleEmitter`

High-performance particle emitter using SoA

| Method | Signature | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `constructor` | `constructor(containerName = 'particles', maxParticles = 100000)` |  |
| `emit` | `emit(x, y, z, vx, vy, vz, life, material = 0, size = 1)` | Emit a single particle |
| `emitBurst` | `emitBurst(x, y, z, count, speed, life, material = 0)` | Emit burst of particles |
| `update` | `update(dt, gravity = -9.8)` | Update all particles (call each frame) |
| `getGPUData` | `getGPUData()` | Get particle data for GPU upload |
| `getStats` | `getStats()` | Get statistics |

## Functions

### `async initResourceManagement(device, options = {})`

Initialize resource management for the game Call this during game initialization after WebGPU device is ready

**Parameters:**

- `device` *(GPUDevice)* — WebGPU device
- `options` *(Object)* — Configuration options

### `frameWrapper(frameCallback)`

Frame wrapper that handles resource management automatically Usage: ```js function gameLoop() { frameWrapper(() => { // Your game update code here updatePhysics(); updateAI(); render(); }); requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop); } ```

**Parameters:**

- `frameCallback` *(Function)* — Your frame update function

### `async frameWrapperAsync(frameCallback)`

Async frame wrapper for async game loops

### `submitPhysicsJob(callback, data = null)`

Submit physics job to scheduler

### `submitAIJob(callback, data = null)`

Submit AI job to scheduler

### `submitStreamingJob(callback, data = null)`

Submit streaming/loading job to scheduler

### `submitCleanupJob(callback, data = null)`

Submit background cleanup job

- `PARTICLE_SCHEMA` — Schema for high-performance particle system using Structure of Arrays
- `TRANSFORM_SCHEMA` — Schema for entity transforms using Structure of Arrays
